findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so key material for the logs bucket encryption key is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the volume of data encrypted under one key and the impact of a key compromise.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, giving only a brief window to cancel an accidental or malicious key deletion; destroying this key would render all log data encrypted under it permanently unrecoverable.
